name: Anchor
description: Get freedom from the burden of invoicing and collections. Anchor is a platform to make your billing cycle flow. Autonomously.

events.d: Create a client contact with name, email, company, phone and custom metadata.
List all contacts, search by name, email or company, or get one contact by ID.
List or search invoices with status, agreement and date filters, or get one invoice by ID.
List or search agreements by status or contact, or get one agreement by ID.
Create a proposal draft from a saved template, optionally linked to a contact.
Publish a proposal draft and send it to the client, with or without a notification email.
List or search proposals by status or contact, or get one proposal by ID.

Bills one charge on an agreement: either a manual service already on the agreement (by service ID) or an out-of-scope charge (by service template ID), invoiced now or scheduled for the issue date (defaults to today…
Add a credit to a client agreement to reduce the amount due on future invoices.
Runs when a proposal is sent, published, reviewed, approved, expired or withdrawn.

events.n: Find or Create Ad Hoc Agreement
events.d: Get the ad-hoc agreement for a contact, creating it if missing, to invoice without a proposal.
Runs when an invoice is issued, paid, voided, or a payment fails, is refunded or disputed.
